claims.claim_text: 把請求分成四級——從勒索軟體、規避防禦等被禁用途，到滲透測試、漏洞掃描等雙重用途，再到安全編碼等良性用途
claims.evidence: Prohibited Use / High-Risk Dual Use / Low-Risk Dual Use / Benign Use tiers with matching examples.

claims.claim_text: 用能力提升幅度、適用範圍、武器化難度、可發現性四個軸給越獄手法打 0 到 4 分，總分對應 CJS-0 到 CJS-4
claims.evidence: Four axes each 0-4, combining to CJS-0 through CJS-4.

claims.claim_text: 找到一個潛伏 16 年的資料競爭……最少只要 20 步狀態轉換就能觸發資料庫毀損
claims.evidence: "It takes only 20 states to witness a missing page in the database"; bug present since 2010 (16 years).

claims.claim_text: dqlite 本身不受影響，因為它靠獨佔鎖把 checkpoint 與寫入操作序列化
claims.evidence: "dqlite is not affected by the bug at all! This is because by taking the write lock for both appending and checkpointing, they cannot proceed simultaneously."

claims.claim_text: SQLite 官方已在 3.51.3 版加入 salt 比對修補
claims.evidence: "Recently SQLite published a new version [links to .../releaselog/3_51_3.html] with a fix to a long-standing bug..."
claims.note: Version confirmed via the linked release-log URL.

claims.claim_text: Ghost 團隊的原話是「就連早期原型開發的短短幾週內，我們就撞上了上述所有問題」
claims.evidence: "even in just a few weeks of early prototyping we were running into the issues described above right away."

claims.claim_text: 目前支援十三種既有網頁框架
claims.evidence: "thirteen web framework integrations"

claims.claim_text: 40 個欄位裡只碰 3 個時，只需掃 40GB 而非 800GB，在真實可觀測性資料上做到 10 到 14 倍壓縮率，相較 Elasticsearch 只有 2 到 3 倍
claims.evidence: "the difference between scanning 800GB and scanning 40GB"; "10–14x compression ratios on real observability data, compared to 2–3x for Elasticsearch."
claims.note: '40 個欄位' is a rounding of source's 'dozens of attributes'; the 800GB/40GB/3-column figures are exact.

claims.claim_text: 每天 10TB 時……月費 1.8 萬到 2.8 萬美元。對照組是 Elasticsearch 在 10TB 規模要價 9.5 萬到 14 萬美元、Loki 需要 180 多個 pod……Datadog 帳單則可能衝破百萬美元
claims.evidence: ClickHouse $18-28K/month at 10TB; Elasticsearch $95-140K/month; Loki 180+ pods; Datadog potentially over $1M/month.

claims.claim_text: 把 rustc 1.98.0-nightly 整套翻譯成約 4600 萬行 C 程式碼，讓 Rust 編譯器能單靠 GCC 加 make 建置
claims.evidence: "rustc 1.98.0-nightly ... converted to 46 million lines of C." Buildable with GCC & make.

claims.claim_text: 不必依賴 LLVM
claims.evidence: "though it does require linking to libLLVM.so.22.1-rust-1.98.0-nightly at runtime since rustc uses LLVM."
claims.note: Original lede overclaimed 'no LLVM dependency'; crustc actually still dynamically links libLLVM.so at runtime — it only removes the need to build LLVM from source. Corrected in roundup.html to '不必自建整套 LLVM 工具鏈（執行時仍動態連結一份 libLLVM.so）'.

claims.claim_text: 作者的 ARM64 Linux 機器上，不開優化、20 條平行編譯工作下約 78 秒可以編完
claims.evidence: "make -j20 ... 1:18.48 total" (~78s, no optimizations, ARM64 Linux).

claims.claim_text: 他們的公式是 overcommit_kbytes = 總記憶體 KB × 0.8 + 2×1048576，保留 20% 給核心結構、外加固定 2GB 給 sidecar 行程，涵蓋超過 99% 的機隊
claims.evidence: "overcommit_kbytes = total_memory_kb × 0.8 + 2 × 1048576"; covers 'over 99% of servers.'

claims.claim_text: 殺掉一個 backend 行程會弄壞共享記憶體區段，逼得 postmaster 得砍光所有連線並進入代價高昂的當機復原
claims.evidence: OOM-killed backend corrupts shared memory; postmaster terminates all backends and enters crash recovery.

claims.claim_text: 在 JDK 27 上，這個遮罩指令在產生的機器碼裡完全消失，(x << 2) & -4 直接變成一條算移位的 lea 指令；同樣的最佳化在 JDK 24 上做不到
claims.evidence: JDK 27 emits single lea, no and; JDK 24 emits the redundant mask.

claims.claim_text: 搭配自製的 67KB x86-64 模擬器 nanox（先前用 v86 沒能成功）
claims.evidence: nanox: 67,074-byte WebAssembly module; v86 panics with Unimplemented GP handler.

claims.claim_text: 快開機靠還原一份 901KB 壓縮快照——只存 128MB 位址空間裡 1052 個非零分頁，達到 4.7 倍壓縮率
claims.evidence: 901 KB snapshot, 1,052 nonzero pages of 128 MiB, ~4.7x compression.

claims.claim_text: 整套跑起來的系統只佔約 4MB，跟 Windows 95 的最低需求相當
claims.evidence: "about four megabytes", comparable to Windows 95's 4 MB minimum.

claims.claim_text: 一份跑了 90 次獨立 agent 的觀察研究……44% 的執行第一次就在容器部署上失敗
claims.evidence: Ninety independent agent runs; container deployment failed first-try in 44% of runs.

claims.claim_text: 把推理強度從 High 拉到 xHigh，一次就做對的比例從 28% 衝到 89%，需要修正的提示次數少了約五倍，代價是多花 9% 到 29% 的成本
claims.evidence: "Raising reasoning effort from High to xHigh lifted first try perfect runs from 28 percent to 89 percent and cut corrective prompts about five fold, for 9 to 29 percent more cost."

claims.claim_text: 反倒是額外接上測試工具，成本多花 42% 到 68%，功能分數與可靠度卻沒有提升
claims.evidence: "The testing tool raised cost by 42 to 68 percent without improving functional score or reliability."

claims.claim_text: 把區塊間隔完全跟網路延遲脫鉤……作者稱之為「極致管線化」……並保證在同步網路下，誠實提案者收錄的交易不會被審查或延後
claims.evidence: "we call this extreme pipelining, decoupling the block interval from network latency"; censorship-resistance guarantee under synchrony confirmed.

claims.claim_text: 在 Monad 200 個驗證節點、每個區塊 5 個提案者的模擬下，定案平均耗時 219 毫秒（推測性定案只要 167 毫秒）
claims.evidence: "finalization averages 219 ms (167 ms to speculative finality)" over Monad's 200 validators, 5 proposers/slot.
